preconditions.description: Input consists of exactly two lines: first line is n, second line is the array a.

preconditions.expression: all(c.isdigit() for c in stdin.split()[0]) and int(stdin.split()[0]) == n
preconditions.description: First line is a single integer n (1 ≤ n ≤ 2e5).

preconditions.expression: len(stdin.split()[1:]) == n and all(c.isdigit() for c in stdin.split()[1:])
preconditions.description: Second line contains exactly n integers a₁, a₂, ..., aₙ (1 ≤ aᵢ ≤ n).

postconditions.description: Output is exactly n space-separated integers d₁, d₂, ..., dₙ, each representing the minimum moves or -1.

postconditions.expression: all(d_i == -1 or (d_i >= 0 and d_i <= n) for d_i in map(int, stdout.split()))
postconditions.description: Each dᵢ is either -1 (impossible) or a non-negative integer ≤ n (minimum moves).

postconditions.expression: all((a_i % 2 == 0 and any(a_j % 2 == 1 for j in range(1, n + 1))) or (a_i % 2 == 1 and any(a_j % 2 == 0 for j in range(1, n + 1))) or d_i == -1 for i in range(1, n + 1))
postconditions.description: If dᵢ ≠ -1, there exists at least one j where aⱼ has opposite parity to aᵢ.

postconditions.expression: all((d_i == -1 and not any((a_j % 2 != a_i % 2) and (reachable(i, j, a) == True) for j in range(1, n + 1))) or (d_i != -1 and any((a_j % 2 != a_i % 2) and (reachable(i, j, a) == True) and (moves(i, j, a) == d_i) for j in range(1, n + 1))) for i in range(1, n + 1))
postconditions.description: For each i, dᵢ is the minimum moves to reach any j with opposite parity aⱼ, or -1 if no such j is reachable. Here, reachable(i, j, a) is True if j can be reached from i via valid jumps, and moves(i, j, a) is the minimum moves to reach j from i.
